# A Comparative Study of DRL Algorithms for Map-Free Robot Navigation With Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer

This repository supports the IEEE Access article by Taner Yilmaz and Omur Aydogmus.

Canonical article DOI: https://doi.org/10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3684520
Software DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20715169
Zenodo record: https://zenodo.org/records/20715169
IEEE Xplore: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11482413/
Repository: https://github.com/tyilmaz23/DRLAlgoMapfree
Paper page: https://tyilmaz23.github.io/DRLAlgoMapfree/
Web of Science UID: WOS:001748497200045
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1721-9071

## Summary

This work compares deep reinforcement learning algorithms for map-free mobile robot navigation and evaluates zero-shot transfer from simulation to real-world robot navigation. It is relevant to researchers studying autonomous navigation, mobile robots, robot learning, reinforcement learning benchmarks, LiDAR-based navigation, and sim-to-real transfer.

## Main Topics

- Deep reinforcement learning for mobile robot navigation
- Map-free navigation without global map input
- Zero-shot sim-to-real transfer
- PPO, SAC, A2C, TD3, and DDPG comparison
- Stable-Baselines3 training and evaluation pipeline
- ROS, Gazebo, and TurtleBot3 deployment context

## Repository Structure

- `drl_nav_repro_repo/`: implementation and reproduction files
- `drl_nav_repro_repo/scripts/`: training, evaluation, and Optuna scripts
- `drl_nav_repro_repo/sim/`: custom simulator and utilities
- `drl_nav_repro_repo/configs/`: environment, reward, and hyperparameter settings
- `drl_nav_repro_repo/docs/`: reproduction and ROS/Gazebo notes
- `docs/`: public paper page and visibility materials
- `metadata/`: structured article metadata
